messages:
Tess (Growth): quick creative ask for next week's launch — need a small benchmark asset bundle: hero diagram (web + print), 2 webinar slides, 1-pager PDF, 3 social tiles (square + story), email header, and an SVG inbound-routing map for HubSpot. Target: Tue EOD 2026-04-07. Who can own?

Ravi (Design): I can take it. File specs? copy? logos?

Tess (Growth): specs: hero web 1400x800, print 8.5x11 PDF, social 1200x1200 + 1080x1920, email header 600x200. SVG must include element IDs for mapping. Copy is minimal — short headlines only. I'll drop final strings into Drive. Logos: only whitelist per Legal.

Jo (Product): uploaded numbers to Drive (CSV + notes). Key: p50=40ms, p95=115ms, cost=$0.0075/1k tokens. README line: "Measured in internal testbeds; not an SLA."

Marta (Marketing Ops): for HubSpot mapping, please export SVG nodes with ids like id=form-email id=seg-webinar id=sfdc-lead. I'll provide a mapping CSV once I see IDs. Example CSV snippet:
```FormField,SegmentName,SFDC_Field
email,Inbound - Launch,Email
company,Inbound - Launch,Company
interest,Benchpack,Bench_Interest__c```

Legal (Legal): quick compliance note — do NOT publish customer logos without explicit written approval. Partner logos on the approved whitelist are OK. Also avoid phrasing that implies a guarantee; use "benchmarked" or "measured in our testbeds."

Ravi (Design): timeline: WIP Mon 09:00 PT (hero + slides first), final Tue 15:00 PT. Will produce EN masters with editable text layers for FR/DE handoff and export an SVG with labeled element IDs. Will upload to Drive and tag @Tess.

Tess (Growth): perfect — priority order: 1) hero + slides 2) routing SVG 3) 1-pager 4) social + email header. Ping here if any blockers. :thumbsup:
